metric_definitions.preprocess_host_ms: JPEG load, resize, ToTensor, normalization, and CPU concatenation
metric_definitions.prefix_alignment_ms: synchronized CUDA-event projection and visual-prefix mapping latency
metric_definitions.gpt2_decoder_ms: synchronized CUDA-event Hugging Face greedy generate latency
metric_definitions.end_to_end_ms: host wall time from preprocessing start through synchronized decode completion

metric_definitions.decoder_ms_per_step: gpt2_decoder_ms / maximum generated sequence length in the batch

metric_definitions.peak_reserved_mib: torch CUDA maximum reserved memory after per-iteration peak reset
